create.name: Margot Anand
create.bio:
Margot Anand is a French-born teacher of Tantra who has spent decades presenting it to Western students as a whole path rather than a set of bedroom techniques. After studying at the Sorbonne in Paris she trained in Gestalt work, bioenergetics, massage, Arica and Integral yoga, and in Hindu and Buddhist Tantra with several teachers, Osho among them, in India.

From that mix she built SkyDancing Tantra, a modern or neo-Tantra that uses the chakras as its main map and combines breath, movement, music, visualisation, ritual and meditation with ideas from psychology and communication training. She founded a network of SkyDancing institutes around the world and still trains certified teachers in the method, alongside a longer programme she calls the Love and Ecstasy Training. Her books on intimacy, pleasure and awakening, among them The Art of Everyday Ecstasy and Love, Sex, and Awakening, have reached a large international readership. She also founded SpiritWorks, which runs pilgrimages and channels donations to local charities in the places it visits. Today she leads week-long residential seminars for singles and couples in several countries, offers an online video course, and keeps an archive of recorded lectures for members.

books.title: The Art of Everyday Ecstasy
books.author: Margot Anand
books.description: Takes the Tantric practices of her earlier work out of the bedroom and into daily life, using the seven chakras as stages for bringing more joy and awareness into work, relationships and ordinary routines.

books.title: Love, Sex, and Awakening: An Erotic Journey from Tantra to Spiritual Ecstasy
books.author: Margot Anand
books.description: A memoir told through twelve episodes from her own life that shaped her understanding of how intimacy and spiritual awakening meet.

books.title: The Art of Sexual Ecstasy
books.author: Margot Anand
books.description: Her first and best-known book, a step-by-step course in SkyDancing Tantra for couples, built around breath, ritual, communication and meditation.

courses.title: The Five Secrets of Love
courses.description: A seven-night residential seminar on the Pacific coast of Costa Rica, open to singles and couples, exploring self-love, meditation and embodied awareness as ways into deeper intimacy, with optional yoga or qigong each morning.

courses.title: The Five Secrets of Love – Thailand
courses.description: A week-long version of her Five Secrets of Love seminar held in Chiang Mai, Thailand.

courses.title: Tantric University
courses.description: A week-long residential programme at Domaine Le Hameau de l'Etoile in the south of France.

courses.title: Margot's Treasures
courses.description: Lifetime online access to her archive of recorded lectures and audio seminars, interviews and a gallery of her paintings.
